finalText:
Build clean now, exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from bundler shape change, rest just deprecation noise:

- `src/core/options.js`: read `options.retries` but new bundler sends `retryCount`. Fixed field name.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: strict boolean check threw on `undefined` (new loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`). Added `undefined` case, treat as disabled.

8 deprecation warnings remain (Buffer(), fs.exists, punycode, etc) — real noise, not errors, harmless unless you want them silenced too.
